decisions.reason: As a separately presented launch that fits the firm's core thermoforming and dental-lab materials business, management is likely to persist unless results clearly deteriorate.
This product also received its own page and sits close to the firm's established materials portfolio, so prior investment and public commitment make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted and appears less central to the firm's strategic push in digital manufacturing, management has less commitment to defend and is more willing to discontinue it.

Although web commitment was limited, the product uses the firm's existing custom earmold and hearing-care capabilities, which gives management a plausible basis to continue it and attribute weaker performance to market timing rather than failure.
